author: Brandjuh
name: CuffBank
short: Every member gets a bank account automatically, on join and in bulk.
description: Red opens a bank account lazily — the record only exists once something touches it, so members are missing from the leaderboard until they use an economy command. This cog opens an account the moment a member joins, and backfills everyone already in the server with one command. An existing balance is never overwritten: opening an account writes the current balance straight back, so leaving and rejoining is not a free reset. Levelling everyone up to a starting amount is a separate, explicit argument to the backfill command, and it only ever raises a balance.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data of its own. It creates and reads bank accounts in Red's own bank, which handles its own data deletion.
